verdict.rationale: Gemini has a documented public API with a machine-readable discovery spec, batch processing and tool support, so core model capabilities can be reached programmatically. However, nothing shows that the consumer app's UI features (Gems, scheduled actions, Connected Apps, Notebooks, Deep Research, memory, code import) are available through it. The probe also describes the developer API as a separate product from the app. Missing for 10: documented API access to Gems, scheduled actions, Connected Apps, Notebooks, Deep Research and memory; any statement or evidence of API–UI parity; independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
